payload.authority: Researcher decision under the project's "locks are immutable" red line and the NOTE-049 / NOTE-050 principle that pending contracts are aligned to the executed path. Because this correction changes a fitted parameter it is explicitly NOT eligible for the erratum layer, which forbids parameter, estimator, seed, scene and config changes; it therefore takes the amendment plus new-run route. Frozen while families 36-43 remain sealed, which is the only thing that makes "not chosen from the outcome" checkable.

formal_config_freeze_precondition.after: formal_config may only be frozen after an executor implementing the decision path named in gate.lock exists and its tests pass, with the code revision fixed.
formal_config_freeze_precondition.before: formal_config could be frozen once every upstream lock existed.
formal_config_freeze_precondition.why: Otherwise the final certificate can name an architecture that nothing implements, which is what happened in the original lineage.

formal_e2_executor.after: experiments.e2_formal.run_formal_e2_full(): reliability_route over independent q_v/q_t, four real agents on escalation, arbitration_support_bridge_v1 then selective_escalation_bridge_v1, and the physical_scene_family cluster bootstrap at the seed frozen in statistics_config.lock. In formal mode a deterministic substitute is refused, retry exhaustion aborts the run, no case is dropped, and non-escalated cases make zero provider calls.
formal_e2_executor.before: gate.run_formal_e2(): apply_gate() routing plus confidence_weighted_arbiter, a deterministic stand-in; llm_arm_evaluated false; scenario-level bootstrap at seed 20260831.
formal_e2_executor.why: The frozen architecture and the executed architecture must be the same one.

reliability_anchor_fitting_pool.after: Reliability anchors fitted on the effective pool that NOTE-048 already approved and that every other fitting stage already used: 31 families / 93 samples, hash bc2ec62a62b4f351f63ce1247e58c2ed4e07a436d7efdde355de1eb18fe3b7a2.
reliability_anchor_fitting_pool.before: Reliability anchors fitted on the clean gate-validation pool as loaded from the manifest: 32 families / 96 samples, NOT applying the NOTE-048 duplicate-identity exclusion.
reliability_anchor_fitting_pool.why: One rule, one pool. Having the gate fitted on 93 and the reliability anchors fitted on 96 means the pipeline disagrees with itself about which scenes it is allowed to have seen.

invariants_preserved.agent_stack_unchanged: validation_pool, agent_schema, llm_runtime, the four prompts, the three JSON schemas, the provider, the model and the inference firewall are all carried forward with unchanged hashes.
invariants_preserved.conflict_operational_unchanged: delta is the disagreement threshold, which did not move, so conflict_operational keeps its identity 6cdfab0fba51c5c37c82981bb35719a08244e52c55629741c15099ddd6e01c26 and is carried forward rather than re-decided.
invariants_preserved.gate_thresholds_unchanged: Re-running the same gate search procedure on the effective-93 stress set reproduces the frozen thresholds exactly: q_vision 1.3157833714234424, q_tof 17.01321693530837, disagreement 0.48965981236738715, fusion weight 0.5. The gate search never used the reliability anchors, so the defect could not reach it. gate.lock is superseded only because it cross-references reliability_config_hash, not because any gate value moved.
invariants_preserved.models_unchanged: The ds_v2 Vision and ToF checkpoints, the preprocessing constants and the single training seed pair are byte-identical; nothing is retrained.
invariants_preserved.original_lineage_retained: freeze/ keeps all 22 original lock files unmodified. The corrective run is a separate directory, so both lineages can be inspected side by side and the supersede is visible rather than implied by an absence.
invariants_preserved.sampling_and_statistics_unchanged: e2_sample_size and statistics_config are carried forward unchanged: the reserved partition, the 384 condition rows, the 10000 replicates, the seed 20260827, the family cluster unit and the class stratification are all exactly as first frozen.
invariants_preserved.severity_unchanged: The severity ladder, the selection rule and the selected values (vision 2.0, tof 0.05) are untouched. No stress operator is added, removed or reparameterised.
invariants_preserved.temperatures_unchanged: temperature_vision 0.16915522430955235 and temperature_tof 0.04978728827972712 were already fitted on the effective 93 by run_gate_validation and are not refitted here.

precondition_evidence.note: The correction is derived entirely from the gate-validation pool (families 20-35) and the already-seen deterministic-gate pilot (families 28-35). No Final E2 quantity exists to have been consulted: the families 36-43 sample directories do not exist, no manifest mentions them, and the absence is verified by a directory-name scan that opens no file.

payload.rationale:
Reason A -- the NOTE-048 exclusion was applied incompletely. gate.run_gate_validation called exclude_duplicate_identity_families() before anything else, so the temperature scaling, the severity ladder, the stress set and the gate threshold search all ran on the effective 31 families / 93 samples. But llm_real_validation._compute_cases() loaded the gate-validation manifest directly and never applied the exclusion, so the reliability anchors were fitted on the original 32 families / 96 samples -- including Empty f27, the family excluded precisely because it duplicates the ds_v2 Empty f15 physical scene the perception models were trained on. reliability_final.lock recorded that boundary honestly rather than hiding it, but recording a defect is not the same as fixing it. This is an implementation defect in applying an already-approved rule, not a new tuning decision: the algorithm, the feature schema, the anchor rule, the temperatures, the stress ladder, the severity rule, the CNN weights, the prompts and the LLM model are all unchanged. The only difference is the fitting pool.
Reason B -- formal_config was frozen before an executor existed for the architecture it names. gate.lock names reliability_routing_v1 and selective_escalation_bridge_v1, but the only available runner was gate.run_formal_e2(), which routes through apply_gate() with a deterministic confidence-weighted stand-in and self-reports llm_arm_evaluated: false. A formal_config that certifies a decision path no runner implements cannot be the configuration a one-shot Final E2 executes under. The corrective run re-freezes formal_config only after the real executor exists, its tests pass, and the code revision is fixed.
Neither reason depends on any Final E2 outcome. Families 36-43 have never been generated, rendered, read or inferred over, before or during this correction.
payload.supersedes: Three lock identities from the original pre-final freeze lineage (freeze/, code_revision f5e6463b976f239849a3e0909d8c7e10a8452cb8): reliability_final (ebf4529a3d411eceaf425d6464f8f7f8f7242cf41859b11aee92dddda5371e1d), gate (1ff2d66745da30a73c3b977de1d34d94c67094ee4b70a49b653d492e931ac0d3) and formal_config (cefb453a80daa9766254dbfd549f5b7642b4be688561d5e8cb9dc80765742ed8). Those three files are NOT deleted and NOT rewritten; they remain in freeze/ as the historical lineage. The corrective run lives in freeze/runs/PFC-001/. Every other lock identity from that lineage is carried forward byte-identically and keeps its hash, which is the machine-checkable form of "not re-decided".
payload.title: Open a pre-final corrective formal run: apply the NOTE-048 duplicate-identity exclusion to the reliability anchor fit, and re-freeze formal_config against a real Full PC-MEF executor. The original 22-lock lineage is retained unchanged as history; only the identities that actually changed are superseded.
